blocks.text: There was no evidence that errors more when the occurred misnamerwas frustrated, tired or angry.没有证据表明，当叫错别人名字的人感到沮丧、厌烦或愤怒时，错误会发生得更多。（2019）

blocks.label: 记忆法
blocks.text: evident的名词形式，“证据”就是很明显的东西啊。

sections.meaning: n. 证据；（法庭）证物，证词

blocks.label: 例句
blocks.text: As the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious.随着经济衰退的迫近，人们变得焦虑起来。
